title: Critical hits for players
source: Critical Rolls (Game Master's Toolbox), Nord Games, pp. 30–39. Open Game Content under OGL 1.0a.

columns.slashing: Brow slash. Double damage, and the target is blinded until the end of its next turn.
columns.piercing: Pierced ear. Maximum damage.
columns.bludgeoning: Bashed nose. Double damage.
columns.magical: Magical barrage. Maximum damage, and an additional target within range is affected at half potency, or the spell's area of effect is increased by 5 ft.

columns.slashing: Hit and hide. Maximum damage, and you can use your reaction to take the Hide action.
columns.piercing: Speed strike. Maximum damage, and you can use your reaction to make another attack.
columns.bludgeoning: Terrifying blow. Maximum damage, and one enemy within 30 feet of you is frightened of you until the end of its next turn.
columns.magical: Arcane advantage. Maximum damage, and you have advantage on your next spell attack roll.

columns.slashing: Terrifying slash. Maximum damage, and the target must make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is frightened of you until the end of its next turn.
columns.piercing: With a sharp stick. Double damage, and the target must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it loses an eye (GM decides which one).
columns.bludgeoning: Bonk on the noggin. Maximum damage.
columns.magical: Spell storm. Double damage.

columns.slashing: Slice to the cheek. Double damage.
columns.piercing: Right in the kisser. Maximum damage, and the target cannot speak for 1d4 rounds.
columns.bludgeoning: Nighty night! Double damage, and the target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is knocked unconscious.
columns.magical: Impact. Maximum damage.

columns.slashing: Bloodied nose. Maximum damage.
columns.piercing: Neck wound. Double damage.
columns.bludgeoning: Stunning blow. Maximum damage, and the target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is stunned.
columns.magical: Spell drain. Double damage, and the target must make a DC 12 saving throw, using its spellcasting ability. On a failed save, it is unable to cast spells on its next turn.

columns.slashing: Vexing cut. Double damage, and the target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it cannot take reactions until the end of your next turn.
columns.piercing: Between the shoulders. Maximum damage.
columns.bludgeoning: Gut punch. Double damage.
columns.magical: Guiding attack. Maximum damage, and the target has disadvantage on saving throws against your spells for 1d4 rounds.

columns.slashing: Follow-up. Maximum damage, and you may make another attack against the same target.
columns.piercing: Press the advantage. Double damage and, if this was a melee attack, you can make a DC 16 Strength (Athletics) check to increase this to triple damage.
columns.bludgeoning: Winded. Maximum damage.
columns.magical: Bombardment. Double damage.

columns.slashing: Nave to chops. Double damage.
columns.piercing: Follow-up. Maximum damage, and you may make another attack with disadvantage against the same target.
columns.bludgeoning: Soften 'em up. Double damage, and the target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it has disadvantage on saving throws until the end of its next turn.
columns.magical: Precise magic. Maximum damage.

columns.slashing: Slash to the ribs. Maximum damage.
columns.piercing: Poke in the belly. Double damage.
columns.bludgeoning: Get back! Maximum damage, and the target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is pushed back 5 ft.
columns.magical: Terrifying display. Double damage, and all enemies that can see you must make a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, they are frightened of you until the end of your next turn.

columns.slashing: Outmaneuver. Maximum damage, and you can use your reaction to take the Disengage action.
columns.piercing: Pinned. Maximum damage, and the target's speed is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn.
columns.bludgeoning: Butterfingers. Maximum damage and, if the target is wielding a weapon, it drops it.

columns.slashing: Sliced tendon. Double damage, and the target's speed is reduced by 1/2 until the end of its next turn.
columns.piercing: In the knee. Maximum damage.
columns.bludgeoning: Low blow. Double damage.
columns.magical: Surge of power. Maximum damage, and you can immediately cast the same spell against the same target, expending a spell slot as normal.

columns.slashing: Sweep the legs. Maximum damage, and the target must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it is knocked prone.

columns.magical: Blast of power. Double damage.

columns.slashing: Calf slash. Double damage.

columns.slashing: Low slash. Maximum damage.

columns.slashing: Commanding presence. Maximum damage, and you can use your reaction to inspire one ally within 30 feet who can hear you. The ally can use their reaction to make one weapon attack.

columns.magical: Unpredictable invisibility. Maximum damage, and you turn invisible until the end of your next turn.

columns.slashing: Cleave. Maximum damage and, if the damage kills the target, any damage that would reduce the target below 0 hit points is applied to another target of your choice within range.
columns.piercing: Grievous wound. Maximum damage, and the target cannot take an action on its next turn.
columns.bludgeoning: Seeing stars. Maximum damage, and the target is stunned until the end of its next turn.
columns.magical: Replenished arcana. Maximum damage, and you regain the spell slot you used to cast this spell.

columns.slashing: Don't lose your head! Quadruple damage and, if the damage the target takes is equal to or greater than 1/2 of its maximum hit points, it is decapitated.
columns.piercing: Pressure point. Quadruple damage, and the target must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is paralyzed.
columns.bludgeoning: Nighty night! Quadruple damage and, if the damage the target takes is equal to or greater than 1/4 of its maximum hit points, it is knocked unconscious.
columns.magical: Rejuvenation. Quadruple damage, and you regain a spell slot. Roll a d6 to determine the level of the spell slot.

columns.slashing: Gutted. Quadruple damage and, if the damage the target takes is equal to or greater than 1/2 of its maximum hit points, it is disemboweled.
columns.piercing: Shot through the heart. Quadruple damage, and the target loses 1/4 of its maximum hit points at the beginning of its turn for 3 rounds.
columns.bludgeoning: Tenderizer. Quadruple damage, and the target becomes vulnerable to bludgeoning damage for 1 minute.
columns.magical: Detonation. Quadruple damage, and all creatures within 15 ft. of the target are also affected.

columns.slashing: I never touched a drop! Quadruple damage and, if the damage the target takes is equal to or greater than 1/4 of its maximum hit points, it loses a leg.
columns.piercing: Chink in the armor. Quadruple damage, and the target becomes vulnerable to piercing damage for 1 minute.
columns.bludgeoning: Shattered knee. Quadruple damage, and the target's speed is reduced by 1/2. Additionally, for every 5 ft. the target moves, it takes 1d6 damage.
columns.magical: Blink and you'll miss it. Quadruple damage, and the target must make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is unable to see you for 1 minute.

columns.slashing: Disarmed. Quadruple damage and, if the damage the target takes is equal to or greater than 1/2 of its maximum hit points, it loses an arm/hand.
columns.piercing: Distracting jab. Quadruple damage, and the target has disadvantage on attacks until the end of the encounter.
columns.bludgeoning: Crushed hand. Quadruple damage, and the target loses use of one of its arms or hands.
columns.magical: Terrifying display. Quadruple damage, and all enemies that can see you must make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, they are frightened of you. An enemy can repeat this saving throw at the end of its turn to stop being frightened.

columns.slashing: Hit and run. Quadruple damage, and you can use your reaction to take the Dash action.

columns.magical: Hit and harm. Quadruple damage, and the target of your attack takes an additional 3d4 force damage.
